title: Strong anti-diagonal eigenvalue property conjecture for stochastic matrices
statement: Let $A$ be a stochastic matrix with distinct eigenvalues. Say that $A$ has the **strong anti-diagonal eigenvalue property** when it satisfies the stronger anti-diagonal eigenvalue condition defined in the paper, and let $H^\lambda$ denote the parameterized family of lower-triangular matrices introduced there. **Strong anti-diagonal eigenvalue property conjecture.** $A$ has the strong anti-diagonal eigenvalue property if and only if it is of the form $H^\lambda$. The conjecture would classify stochastic matrices with distinct eigenvalues satisfying this strengthened spectral property; the paper states that it can be proved for $n\leqslant4$, while the general case is left open.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2102.08469

Status: **open** according to the source (as of February 2021). “We therefore make the following conjecture which we offer as an open problem.”
source_name: John R. Britnell and Mark Wildon, “Involutive random walks on total orders and the anti-diagonal eigenvalue property”, arXiv:2102.08469 (2021).
